response: Yes, volumetric analysis of head and neck paragangliomas is worth the effort. It provides a more accurate measurement of tumor size compared to traditional two-dimensional methods, allowing for better assessment of treatment response and disease progression. Volumetric analysis can also help identify small changes in tumor size that may not be apparent with other measurement methods, which is important for monitoring patients with these tumors. Additionally, it can aid in surgical planning and radiation therapy targeting. Overall, the extra effort required for volumetric analysis can lead to improved patient outcomes and more effective management of head and neck paragangliomas.
